REVIEW: BLOCKED
Reviewed-SHA: c62273b9790a71ad89a7799b5b067fb145faf591

Local run at this head: `npm test` 908/908 passed, `npm run check` passed, `npm run build` passed. The hosted `test` check (including the new PR-description step) is green on this head. The branch is behind `main` but merges cleanly, and the merged tree passes 958/958.

Findings:
1. `js/progress-board-model.js:19` (`taskIdentity`). Any executor containing "orchestrator" is shown as provider "Anthropic", model "Claude Opus 5.5". Nothing in the task record states that model, so the board presents a fabricated fact on every orchestrator card and in the modal. Fix: use `task.provider`/`task.model` when CARR supplies them; otherwise show "Unknown" / "Not recorded" (the same way `effort` already falls back to `unknown`).
2. `js/progress-board.js:86-88` (`showTask`). A missing `task.repo` defaults to `jbookout/carr-system`. It is then displayed as the Repository and used to build the PR link, so a doctorcre-app task with `pr` set but no `repo` links to the wrong repository's PR of the same number. Fix: show "Not recorded" and render `PR #n` as plain text (no link) when `repo` is absent.
3. `js/progress-board-model.js:39-40` (`relatedQuestions`). Besides explicit `question_ids`, any question whose id merely contains the task id is attached. The test is titled "by explicit reference", but a task id like `board-1` would pull in `board-12`'s questions. Fix: match explicit `question_ids` only (or have CARR publish the link) and add a negative test.

Clean: all text goes through `textContent`; links pass `safeLink` (http/https only, `noopener noreferrer`); PR numbers and repo slugs are validated before building URLs; the completed grid collapses to one column on phone and the modal rows stack; reduced motion is honored; the PR-description CI step is tested and fails closed.
